create_GaussianToyDataset: create a GaussianToyDataset with class weights, sigmas, dimensionality, and sigma for overlapping Gaussian means
create_PRNGSequence: create a PRNGSequence from an integer seed or JAX PRNGKey for reproducible random number generation
test_sample_points: test sampling points from the GaussianToyDataset returning examples and ground truth labels
test_evaluate_points: test evaluating sampled points under the Gaussian mixture to get per-class probability distributions
test_sample_rankings: test sampling rankings and grouping labels from probability distributions for multiple readers
test_vary_number_of_readers: test varying the number of readers per example by randomly discarding readers with Poisson sampling
